preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have the owner role

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable token swapping and liquidity additions. This will stop all transactions that rely on the swapAndLiquify functionality, effectively freezing transfers for regular users while the owner remains unaffected.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The RISING contract has an owner-only function setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled() that controls whether automatic swapping and liquidity addition is enabled. By setting this to false, the owner can disable the swapAndLiquify functionality, which will stop all transactions that rely on it. This effectively freezes transfers for regular users while the owner remains unaffected. The vulnerability is that the owner has excessive privilege to disable core contract functionality.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the swap and liquify functionality.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner address from the contract using the owner() function.
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner.
3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) on the target contract.
4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.
